proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_ac_set_base
proposed_widenings.justification: Passive magic items still cannot express a base AC replacement formula in PassiveMechanics.grants, even though the same rule shape exists for ongoing spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The robe grants advantage only on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, not on all saving throws.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

notes: No content file authored. The item kind and passive family fit, and attunement restriction, modify_save_dc, spell_attack_roll, and unarmored already exist, but the passive AC-formula replacement and magical-source save filter do not.
